note: Facts are short summaries of the linked NASA records. growSols and food are game-balance values; zinnia has food 0.

crops.name: Red Romaine Lettuce
crops.fact: NASA grew "Outredgeous" red romaine lettuce in Veggie, a plant box built for the Space Station.

crops.name: Mizuna Greens
crops.fact: Mizuna mustard greens grew on the Space Station in 2019 to test how light colour changes plants.

crops.name: Radish
crops.fact: Radishes grew in NASA's Advanced Plant Habitat for the PH-02 experiment. This batch grew on Earth to compare with space.

crops.name: Chile Pepper
crops.fact: In October 2021 an astronaut tasted a red chile pepper grown on the Space Station. The seeds were planted that July.
crops.sourceTitle: Expedition 66 astronauts sample chile peppers grown on the International Space Station

crops.name: Zinnia
crops.fact: Zinnia seeds grown on the Space Station came back to Earth and were planted again in 2018.
crops.sourceTitle: Space Zinnias: Growing Seeds from Space
